value.title: Immutable route counters preserve closed labels without recording locks

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Extends the earlier counter-byte-bound notes with request telemetry's fixed-table mechanism. At #266 head dabbd04062d73a12ffef2a831bd7e2f2030c8f8a, http/mod.rs:609-615 constructs counters from Endpoint::ALL. http/route_counts.rs:115-159 sorts/deduplicates static templates once; recording only binary-searches the immutable slice, and unknown templates increment unmatched without inserting a key. Preserve this closed vocabulary alongside fixed method buckets and query-shape slots when adding diagnostics.

The round-one mutex/map was bounded but not an atomic-only hot path. Round two removed it without admitting first-seen labels or allocations. Check both retention and recording cost; a security pass alone is not performance approval.

Snapshots read atomics independently, and total is the wrapping sum of the same sampled values emitted (route_counts.rs:163-196), not a transactional instant. Do not treat it as an authorization or strict accounting invariant. Keep the existing unknown-template and concurrent-snapshot regressions; both passed in exact-head JUnit artifact 14512742291. No local builds or live-cost measurement were performed. Final security evidence: outputs/2026-11/19-verdict-pr-266-dabbd04.dd.json under this role.
